kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the 11-toxin table; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis rule (the toxin axis: 11 named carcinogens; the organ axis: the target organs and their cancer types) — KYP's synthesis of the table into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the table sequentially without a unified protocol; the framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (LIVER ANGIOSARCOMA ARSENIC VINYL CHLORIDE / TOBACCO EIGHT ORGANS / RADON BASEMENT URANIUM / NITROSAMINES SMOKED STOMACH) — no mnemonic prints on the page.
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints anywhere on book 221 (VLM census confirmed); the four codes are KYP's design.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on the page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for pdf 243). The page is a single pure-text table — TOXIN | EXPOSURE | ORGAN | IMPACT — with 11 toxin entries (some with multiple organs: arsenic has 3, tobacco smoke has 8, ethanol has 3, ionizing radiation has 2). The visual is an ORIGINAL KYP adaptation rendering the table as a toxin-organ-impact grid map (no source figure to redraw). The table is carried verbatim in the note's table block. No copyrighted photographs; no margin mnemonics (VLM confirmed); the KYP memory layer is original.
